children: Beazer Homes issued a conditional notice to redeem the $350.0 million of 7.250% senior notes due 2029 at 101.208% plus accrued interest, subject to the closing of its merger with Dream Finders.
Issued conditional notice to redeem $350.0M aggregate principal of 7.250% senior notes due 2029 on Oct 20, 2026.
Redemption price is 101.208% of principal plus accrued and unpaid interest to the redemption date.
Redemption is conditioned on the Merger with Dream Finders and receipt of funds sufficient to pay the redemption price.
Notes will not be due and payable unless the Merger and funding condition are satisfied or waived by Beazer Homes.
